title: TRX300 connector, diode, terminal and wire-color-label location ground truth

source.coordinate_system: Zero-based pixels, origin upper-left; x increases rightward and y downward; bbox is [x,y,width,height].

annotation_policy.coordinate_extraction: Extents of red rectangles and small red terminal markers were extracted using a red color mask and connected components.
annotation_policy.scope: Location/region truth only. The annotations do not assert diode polarity/type, wire-color text transcription or conductor association, net membership, terminal function, or other unmarked semantics.
annotation_policy.bbox_semantics: For connector, diode and wire-color-label entries, the bounding box is the markup extent and represents the user's marked target region, not pixel-exact segmentation. For terminals, bbox_xywh_px is the marker extent and point_xy_px is its center.
annotation_policy.matching_thresholds: Not set in this fixture; establish category-specific IoU/distance rules after comparing current predictions.
annotation_policy.status: Coordinate ranges and category counts validated; visual ground-truth count approval remains a separate review step.

connector.description: Connector locations as marked by the user.

diode.description: Diode locations as marked by the user.

terminal.description: Terminal locations as marked by the user.

wire_color_label.description: Wire-color label locations as marked by the user.
